name: sitemap-page
title: Sitemap page
description: A human sitemap: every section as a block with its pages as a nested list, so people and crawlers have a second way to find a page.
docs: Pass sections with nested pages; an entry without href is a group and renders as text. Two levels read best: anything deeper folds into a details element, and open: true keeps the branch of the current page open. The navigation is named Sitemap; rename it with label when a page has more than one. Pass labels to translate the page counts and linkAs={Link} for your router.
